content.short: Empowa is the first RealFi property platform on Cardano to combine blockchain technology with sustainable housing.
content.description: We believe in empowering people to build a better future. There is a backlog of 50 million homes in Africa - a $1 trillion business opportunity. Many people think that this backlog is due to poverty - it is not. It is due to structural issues that can be overcome. Empowa is on a mission to build a decentralised funding platform for affordable housing in Africa a #RealFi application. Empowa is linking DeFi to real world property assets in the youngest and fastest growing markets in the world.
